# Midland Corporate Bond Fund

## Investment Guidelines

Version 1. Effective from 1 January 2024. These Guidelines form part of the Fund's Investment Policy Statement and bind the Portfolio Manager in respect of all dealing on behalf of the Fund.

### 1. Credit quality

1.1 Holdings rated below investment grade shall not exceed 20% of the Fund's net asset value. For this purpose "below investment grade" means rated below BBB- by S&P or below Baa3 by Moody's (the "High Yield" bucket). Where a proposed transaction would take the High Yield bucket to 90% or more of this limit, the Portfolio Manager shall notify the Chief Investment Officer before dealing.

### 2. Interest rate risk

2.1 The modified duration of the Fund shall be maintained between 3 and 7 years. Every proposal to extend or shorten duration must state the expected post-trade modified duration of the Fund; a proposal that omits it cannot be assessed against this Section.

### 3. Exceptions

3.1 A breach of Section 1.1 may be waived for up to 30 days with the written approval of the Portfolio Manager, the Chief Investment Officer, the Compliance Officer and the Head of Risk. A breach of Section 2.1 may be waived for up to 30 days with the written approval of the Portfolio Manager, the Chief Investment Officer and the Head of Risk. All waivers require four-eyes control.
